tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind every page; the ground cards and tables sit on.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, modals, menus, inputs.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Table header row, toolbars, sunken areas inside a surface, zebra rows.

tokens.name: bg-muted
tokens.usage: Hover on neutral controls and rows, neutral badge fill, skeleton base.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Selected table rows and active nav items.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default hairline: card edges, table row dividers, section dividers.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Dividers that must read over bg-subtle; disabled control borders.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and secondary buttons. Meets 3:1 on bg-surface, bg-subtle and bg-canvas.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, table cell values. On every bg-* token.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, column headers, metadata, descriptions. On every bg-* token.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, helper text, placeholders, timestamps. On bg-surface, bg-subtle and bg-canvas.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and values only (exempt from contrast minimums).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on text-primary fills (tooltips, the bulk-action bar).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: CommerceOS cobalt. Primary buttons, active tabs, links, checked controls, focus. As text, on bg-surface, bg-canvas and brand-subtle.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of brand elements.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of brand elements.

tokens.name: brand-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind brand text: brand badges, selected chips, info-like highlights.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px. 3:1 or better on every bg-* token.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links; an alias of brand.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Delivered, paid, in stock, completed. As text and icon on bg-surface or success-subtle.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending, low stock, awaiting payment, partial. As text and icon on bg-surface or warning-subtle.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, cancelled with loss, out of stock, overdue, destructive actions. As text on bg-surface or danger-subtle; as a fill under on-danger.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the danger button.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of danger badges and alerts; danger field background is not used.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Processing, in transit, informational notices. As text and icon on bg-surface or info-subtle.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of info badges and alerts.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and drawers.

tokens.name: tooltip-bg
tokens.usage: Tooltip and bulk-action-bar fill; text on it is text-inverse.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Manrope, semibold. Sizes step by 2–6px; every line height sits on the 4px half-step of the 8px grid.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Page title, once per page, in the page header.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Modal titles, detail-panel titles, major section headers.

groups.name: Body
groups.note: 14px is the default UI size; 13px is for dense tables and secondary text.

styles.name: body-md
styles.sample: Stock is reserved when the order is confirmed.
styles.usage: Default text: form values, descriptions, menu items, paragraphs.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Updated 4 min ago by Priya N.
styles.usage: Table cells in compact density, metadata, secondary lines.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button labels, tab labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Must be a whole number of units.
styles.usage: Helper text, field errors, timestamps, chart axis labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Group labels in menus and side navigation. Uppercase via CSS, never typed in caps.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: All figures use tabular numerals so columns align.

styles.name: metric-lg
styles.usage: KPI values in MetricCard. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: metric-sm
styles.usage: Numeric table cells and inline totals. Tabular numerals, right-aligned.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: SKUs, order IDs, barcodes, API keys. Geist Mono.

spacing.note: 8px system with a 4px half-step for tight internal gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding, gaps inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, button-group gap, label-to-input gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding, table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), gap between form fields, toolbar padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding (default), modal padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections, page side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Large empty and error states.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Full-page empty and error states.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, kbd hints, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, search fields, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dropdown menus, toasts, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and drawers.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, avatars, segmented-tab pills.

shadow.note: Borders separate surfaces; shadows only mark things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs, barely there.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, popovers, tooltips, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and drawers only.

size.note: Control and row heights, all on the 4px half-step.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs: table toolbars, inline row actions.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height for buttons, inputs, selects, search fields.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions in modals and forms that need weight; touch layouts.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Table row height in compact density (inventory, order lists).

tokens.name: row-default
tokens.usage: Table row height in default density.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons, inputs, menu items, badges.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Standalone icons, alerts, toasts.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and page toolbars.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus and popovers.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modal and its overlay.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast viewport.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips, above everything.
